title: Boot Step Simulation
statement: Let $S$ be a deterministic Boolean Turing machine, $A$ a nondeterministic Boolean Turing machine, and let the clock loop flag and choice bit $b$ be fixed. For a configuration $c$ of $S$ on a Boolean input, suppose its state is $q$. Then one host-machine step under $b$, starting from the boot configuration of $c$, equals the boot configuration of the one-step successor of $c$ under $S$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration c of S on a Boolean input
A state q of S such that c has state q
